title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Sidekick
moral: The best teams look after each other, no matter what.

pages.content: {{NAME}} flew above the big city. His cape snapped in the wind. The city had tall towers and bright lights. Then he heard a crash far below. He looked down and saw a small robot stuck under a heavy rock. The robot could not move.
